== Title ==
<span lang="ja">おまえはダゴバ星系に行くのだ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">自分の支配フェイズに２フォース消費して[Hoth]がついた自分の任意の能力値＞1のキャラクターを1人、自分の人員がいる[Dagobah]がついたロケーションに移動させる。ダゴバの位置に移動させるなら、移動にはフォースを消費せず、そこに人員がいる必要もない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「そこでお前はヨーダから学ぶ。私の師たるジェダイ・マスターだ」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — You Will Go To The Dagobah System.

'''Lore''' — There you will learn from Yoda. He is the Jedi Master who taught me.

'''Game text''' — During your control phase, use 2 Force to move one of your [Hoth] characters of ability greater than 1 to a [Dagobah] location where you have presence. If moving to a Dagobah location, the move costs no Force and does not need presence.

Paid move costs 2 Force; English costs 1 Force. Free clause uses ダゴバの位置 (location), not English Dagobah site. Title uses hiragana おまえ; lore uses お前.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-youwillgotothedagobahsystem.gif|Original English face]], [[You Will Go To The Dagobah System]].</ref>
